_readme: WHAT: All fixed (non-database) text and SEO for the storefront. HOW IT IS USED: pages read this through getSiteContent() in src/modules/site-content/site-content.service.ts. EDITING: change text in Admin > Page Content (saved to the database, overrides this file, live instantly) or edit this file and redeploy. Admin > Page Content > Reset to defaults goes back to this file. COMMENTS: any key starting with '_' (like this one) is a note for editors; it is never shown on the site and cannot be changed from admin. TOKENS: {{siteName}}, {{contactEmail}}, {{returnWindowDays}}, {{freeShippingThreshold}}, {{signatureThreshold}} are filled in from Admin > Settings. RULES: keep every key; only change the text values. Lists can grow or shrink. Products, categories, banners, prices and articles are NOT here - they come from the database.

siteConfig._sitemap: Static pages listed in /sitemap.xml. priority (0.0-1.0) and changeFrequency (daily|weekly|monthly|yearly) are hints to search engines. label is shown in Admin > SEO.
siteConfig._noindexPaths: URL prefixes search engines must NOT index (private, cart, account, search results). Pages under these paths get a noindex robots tag and are left out of the sitemap.

seo.description: Meet {{siteName}}: moissanite and lab-grown diamond engagement rings and fine jewelry, handmade to order in sterling silver and 10K–18K solid gold.

about.title: About {{siteName}}
about.body:
{{siteName}} makes moissanite and lab-grown diamond jewelry by hand, one order at a time. Every engagement ring, wedding band, pair of earrings, pendant and bracelet is made to order for you.

## Handmade to order

Nothing sits on a shelf. Once you order, our jewelers make your piece in 7–10 business days. Every piece is hallmarked for metal purity.

## Moissanite and lab-grown diamonds

Most of our designs use moissanite: colorless (D-E-F) or in colors like champagne, green, blue, yellow and grey. Moissanite is conflict-free, has more fire than a diamond and passes a standard diamond tester. Some designs are also available with lab-grown diamonds.

Certificates are available on request for an additional cost (IGI for lab-grown diamonds).

## Sterling silver or solid gold

Every design is listed in 925 sterling silver. You can also have it made in 10K, 14K or 18K solid yellow, white or rose gold. Gold and other upgrades are priced on request; we send you a quote before you pay.

## Make it yours

Change the metal, stone color or ring size, or add an engraving. Tap **Customize** on any piece, or email [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}).

seo.title: FAQ: Diamonds, Ring Sizing & Returns
seo.description: Answers about moissanite and lab-grown diamonds, certificates, custom metals, ring sizing, making and shipping times and {{returnWindowDays}}-day returns at {{siteName}}.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body:
Quick answers about our stones, custom orders, shipping and returns. Can't find your answer? Email [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}) and we'll get back to you.

## Stones and certificates

### What stones do you use?

Most pieces use moissanite, colorless (D-E-F) or in colors like champagne, green, blue and yellow. Some designs are also available with lab-grown diamonds. All our stones are conflict-free, and our moissanite passes a diamond tester.

### Do your pieces come with a certificate?

A certificate is available on request for an additional cost: IGI for lab-grown diamonds, and a moissanite certificate for moissanite pieces. Every piece is hallmarked for metal purity.

## Custom orders and ring sizing

### Can I choose a different metal, stone or size?

Yes. Every design is listed in 925 sterling silver, and you can ask for 10K, 14K or 18K solid gold, a different stone color or a custom ring size. Tap **Customize** on the product page and we'll send you a price before you pay. Not sure of your size? See our [ring size guide](/ring-size-guide).

### How long does my order take?

Every piece is made to order. Making takes 7–10 business days, then standard shipping takes 7–14 business days. Express shipping is available at checkout.

## Shipping and returns

### Do I need to sign for my order?

Orders of {{signatureThreshold}} or more need a signature on delivery. You'll see shipping options and delivery times at checkout, before you pay.

### What is your return policy?

You can return unworn pieces in their original condition within {{returnWindowDays}} days of delivery. Engraved pieces and custom orders (a different metal, stone or size) can't be returned.

seo.title: How to Clean & Care for Moissanite Jewelry
seo.description: How to clean moissanite and lab-grown diamond jewelry at home, care for sterling silver and solid gold, and store your pieces so they keep their sparkle.

care-guide.title: How to clean and care for your jewelry
care-guide.body:
Moissanite and lab-grown diamonds stay bright for years with a little care. Lotion, soap and skin oils can dull the sparkle over time, so a gentle clean now and then keeps your jewelry looking its best.

## Everyday habits

- Take your jewelry off before showers, skincare, workouts and swimming pools.
- Keep it away from oils, perfumes and chemical dyes.
- Store each piece in a soft pouch or on a flat surface so stones can't scratch other jewelry.

## How do I clean my ring at home?

1. Fill a small bowl with warm water and add a few drops of mild soap.
2. Let your jewelry soak for a few minutes.
3. Gently brush around the stone and setting with a soft brush.
4. Rinse with warm water and pat dry with a soft cloth.

## Need help?

Have a question about caring for your piece? Email [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}).

seo.title: Ring Size Chart: How to Find Your Size
seo.description: Find your ring size at home in minutes. Measure a ring you own and match it to our US, UK and EU size chart. We make sizes 3 to 10¾, custom on request.

ring-size-guide.title: Ring size guide: how to find your ring size
ring-size-guide.body:
The easiest way to find your ring size at home is to measure the inside of a ring that already fits, then match it to the chart below. A ring that fits well slides over your knuckle with a little resistance and doesn't spin once it's on.

## Tips for an accurate measurement

Your finger size changes a little with temperature and time of day, so:

- Measure at the end of the day, when your fingers are warm.
- Don't measure right after exercise or when you're cold.
- Wide bands (4 mm or wider) feel tighter than thin ones. For a wide band, go up a quarter to half a size.

## How do I measure a ring I already own?

Take a ring that fits the same finger well. Lay it on a ruler and measure the **inside diameter**, from inside edge to inside edge (don't include the metal). Then find your size in the ring size chart.

| Inside diameter | Circumference | US / CA size | UK / AU size | EU size |
| --------------- | ------------- | ------------ | ------------ | ------- |
| 14.1 mm         | 44.2 mm       | 3            | F            | 44      |
| 14.9 mm         | 46.8 mm       | 4            | H            | 47      |
| 15.7 mm         | 49.3 mm       | 5            | J 1/2        | 49      |
| 16.5 mm         | 51.9 mm       | 6            | L 1/2        | 52      |
| 17.3 mm         | 54.4 mm       | 7            | N 1/2        | 54      |
| 18.1 mm         | 57.0 mm       | 8            | P 1/2        | 57      |
| 19.0 mm         | 59.5 mm       | 9            | R 1/2        | 59      |
| 19.8 mm         | 62.1 mm       | 10           | T 1/2        | 62      |

## Which sizes do you make?

We make US sizes 3 to 10¾ in quarter sizes. Need a different size? Custom sizes are available on request — tap **Customize** on the product page.

## Not sure of your size?

Email us at [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}) and we'll help you choose the closest half or quarter size before your ring is made.

seo.title: Shipping & Returns: Delivery Times
seo.description: Every piece is handmade to order in 7–10 business days, then ships in 7–14 business days. Express shipping at checkout and {{returnWindowDays}}-day returns.

shipping-returns.title: Shipping & returns
shipping-returns.body:
Every piece is made to order. Here's how long it takes and how returns work.

## Making and shipping times

- **Making your piece:** 7–10 business days.
- **Standard shipping:** 7–14 business days after your piece is made.
- **Express shipping:** available at checkout.
- **Free shipping:** orders over {{freeShippingThreshold}} ship free.
- **Signature required:** orders of {{signatureThreshold}} or more need a signature on delivery.

You'll see your shipping options and costs at checkout, before you pay.

## {{returnWindowDays}}-day returns

You can return unworn pieces within **{{returnWindowDays}} days** of delivery, in their original condition and packaging.

**How to return:** email [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}) with your order number and we'll send you instructions.

**What can't be returned:** engraved pieces and custom orders (made in a different metal, stone or size).

seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: How {{siteName}} collects, uses and protects your personal information for orders, inquiries and account security, and how to see or delete it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
This policy explains what personal information {{siteName}} collects and why. We only use the information we need to deliver your orders safely, keep accurate records of your stones, protect your account and answer your questions.

## Information we collect

- **Account and order details:** your name, email address, shipping and billing addresses, phone number, and the items in your wishlist or cart.
- **Security information:** encrypted session IDs and security timestamps. We use these only to prevent unauthorized access and fraud.
- **Payments:** card and UPI payments are handled directly by our PCI-compliant payment providers, Stripe and Razorpay. Your full card number is never sent to or stored on {{siteName}} servers.

## Cookies and analytics

Essential cookies keep your cart, wishlist and account working securely. Optional analytics cookies only load if you accept them in our cookie banner.

## Your rights

- **See your data:** view your profile and orders at any time in your account.
- **Delete your data:** ask us to permanently delete your account and anonymize your data.
- **Tax records:** we must keep order totals for tax purposes, but your personal details are removed from them when you delete your account.

Questions? Email [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}).

seo.title: Terms of Service
seo.description: The terms for buying from {{siteName}}: prices, made-to-order and custom pieces, stone and metal descriptions, delivery and returns.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.body:
These terms apply to every purchase from {{siteName}}. Please read them before you order.

## Prices, stock and accepting your order

- Prices are confirmed by our system at checkout.
- When you start to pay, we hold the item for you while your payment provider approves the payment.
- If an order is affected by an obvious pricing or typing error, we may cancel or refund it before it ships.

## Stone and metal descriptions

Our pieces use moissanite or lab-grown diamonds, as stated on each product page. Carat weights for moissanite are diamond-equivalent weights (DEW) and, like metal weights, are approximate. Certificates are available on request for an additional cost.

## Delivery and signatures

Every piece is made to order, then shipped to the address you gave us. Orders of {{signatureThreshold}} or more must be signed for on delivery.

## Returns and care

You can return eligible unworn pieces within {{returnWindowDays}} days, as explained in our [shipping and returns policy](/shipping-returns).

Questions about these terms? Email [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}).
